build_fx_graph_module: build a torch.fx.GraphModule by symbolically tracing a PyTorch model with module expansion into operators
create_fx_symbolic_tracer: create an FXSymbolicTracer instance to generate FX graphs from PyTorch models for ONNX export
trace_model_with_concrete_args: trace a PyTorch model or callable into an FX graph using concrete_args to specialize and remove control flow
expand_modules_into_operators: expand all sub-modules of a PyTorch nn.Module into call_function nodes for ONNX-friendly graph structure
generate_fx_graph_module: generate a torch.fx.GraphModule from a model with input binding, placeholder reordering, and pre-export passes
